scope: Correct dense LDLsolve for inconsistent tall exact systems
Add dense cholesky_solve and sparse LDLsolve/cholesky_solve
Preserve coefficient class, multiple right-hand sides, original-source admission and checked unique Hermitian least-squares semantics
limits: Complex and active callback requests use the existing checked Q(i) lane with at most 32 axes and 4096-bit rational components. Standalone literal-rational sparse inputs retain their sparse checked kernel. Underdetermined and rank-deficient systems refuse, including an empty RHS. No new symbolic fallback or portable matrix proof claim is introduced.

validation.isolated_sympy_1_14_0: All 144 ordinary fixtures were exercised directly against installed isolated upstream SymPy 1.14.0 and matched. This was a direct Python oracle exercise because that isolated interpreter lacked pytest, not candidate execution.
validation.comparators: Exact solution values, original Hermitian normal residuals, coefficient class identity, result shape, zero-unknown dimensions and underdetermined refusal. Native-only cases retain stricter full-rank, held-domain, source-mutation, bounded-storage and cumulative-request obligations.
validation.python_ast: Passed for all four implementation/test files.
validation.independent_review: Two independent agents reviewed source capture, native lane selection, original owner rechecks, full-rank obligation even for zero RHS columns, subclass publication and cumulative callback cancellation. No concrete blocker found.
validation.candidate_execution: Not executed; the production extension remains unavailable after prior dependency-build SIGKILL and executor loss. No compiler or candidate-runtime pass is claimed.
validation.ci: The 214 focused public cases are selected in the existing actual-extension CI suite.

adjacent_validation_correction: The existing sparse exact-solve audit records eight upstream false-inconsistency cases and their correct native-only classification. Their mathematical acceptance assertions remain unchanged; combined isolated QR/exact-solve execution reports 62 passed and 40 skipped.
claims: No WS10, campaign, compatibility, performance or proof-class gate is closed or promoted.
